results.name: date_metadata
rows: Monthly claims bordereau file label in `M-YYYY` form, e.g. `9-2025`. Filter to one value for a point-in-time snapshot.

`Nullable(DateTime)`; non-NULL on a minority of rows (probed). For a term's actual end use `coalesce(policy_effective_end_timestamp, policy_expiration_timestamp)` — the term-end definition the `dbt_mga` marts carry.

Effective start (`Nullable(DateTime)`) of the policy term this quote belongs to; pairs with `policy_expiration_timestamp` (term end = `coalesce(policy_effective_end_timestamp, policy_expiration_timestamp)`). Use it for exposure / in-force windows — not for when the policy was sold (that is `policy_issued_timestamp`).

Per-dwelling `dwelling` coverage — data schema LimitAndLossValuationOption (`limit`, `loss_valuation_option`) (ryerson coverage schema); maps to peril "Dwelling". This column is the Coverage A dwelling limit in whole dollars (`Int64`), typically in the hundreds of thousands (probed). Feeds the spine's `dwelling_tiv` together with private-structures, personal-property, ALC/FRV, and extended-replacement-cost limits.
`Nullable(DateTime)` but never NULL in prod (probed). The derived `issued_count`/`quoted_count` sequencing uses it to date cancellations and reinstatements.

When this quote (version) was issued, `Nullable(DateTime64(6))`. NULL on every non-`Issued` row, so `isNotNull(quote_issued_timestamp)` is equivalent to `quote_status = 'Issued'`. Use it to time individual endorsements/renewals; use `policy_issued_timestamp` for when the policy itself was bound.

`Int64` revision counter within a `quote_id`, starting at `1` (heavily edited quotes run to hundreds). A `quote_id` can appear with more than one version, so current quote state = highest version: `ORDER BY quote_version DESC LIMIT 1 BY quote_id` — the latest-version state the `dbt_mga` marts reflect.
